text:
Predicates:
GrowthStock(x) ::: x is a growth stock.
BoughtForAppreciation(x) ::: x is bought to earn profits from rapid price appreciation.
SuitableForRetirement(x) ::: x is suitable for a retirement fund.
MatureStock(x) ::: x is a mature stock.
Premises:
∀x (GrowthStock(x) → BoughtForAppreciation(x)) ::: All growth stocks are bought to earn profits from rapid price appreciation.
∀x (BoughtForAppreciation(x) → ¬SuitableForRetirement(x)) ::: If a stock is bought to earn profits from rapid price appreciation, then it is not suitable for a retirement fund.
∃x GrowthStock(x) ::: Some stocks are growth stocks.
∀x (MatureStock(x) → SuitableForRetirement(x)) ::: All mature stocks are suitable for a retirement fund.
MatureStock(ko) ::: KO is a mature stock.
Conclusion:
∃x (x = ko) ::: KO is a stock.
